headline_findings: Offline on-device transcription works on this device and OS with all radios off (0.32 s cold, 0.15 s warm for the fixture).
Local notifications deliver with the app force-quit and with the phone locked.
Keychain: only the AfterFirstUnlock classes are readable while locked; background window about 25 s.
Recording survives 10 s of background and 10 s of lock without a background audio mode; process death leaves an unfinalized WAV header.
Pending-notification limit is 64 with oldest-added eviction.
Handoff carries only the identifier; hostile URLs are rejected; cold-launch URL arrives before the webview is ready.
Large text at maximum clips labels in CaptureProbe, AudioProbe and CredentialProbe.
